description: Invite a guest to an existing trip by email. Requires permission to add guests. Confirmed favorites may be added directly. The API can return success without adding a guest; check collaborators afterward. Use this tool for existing trips; guest_invites is only processed during trip creation. Safety: Open-world: guest invitations can send email to external recipients and grant them trip access. Destructive: guest invitations can send email that cannot be unsent and expose trip data to recipients. This applies even when invitations are optional or a favorite guest is added directly.

invited_user_email.description: Email address of the guest to invite.

permissions.description: Optional invitation permissions. Omitted fields use the API defaults, limited by the inviter's permissions.

is_travelling.description: True for travelling; false for following.
